50:2: Nay, they wondered that a warner came to them from among themselves, and the disbelievers said, 'This is an astonishing thing!'
50:3: When we have died and become dust? That is a far return, they say.
50:4: Indeed, We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a preserving book.
50:5: Nay, they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused state.
50:6: Did they not look at the sky above them, how We built it and adorned it, and there are no rifts in it.
50:7: And the earth We spread out, placed therein firm mountains, and grew therein of every beautiful pair.
50:8: As an insight and a reminder for every turning servant.
50:9: And We sent down from the sky blessed water, and caused to grow therewith gardens and grain to be harvested.
50:10: And tall palm trees that have arranged buds.
50:11: As a provision for the servants, and with it We gave life to a dead land; thus is the emergence.
50:12: Before them the people of Noah, the people of al-Rass, and Thamud denied.
50:13: And 'Ad, and Pharaoh, and the brothers of Lot.
50:14: And the people of Aykah and the people of Tubba' as well. All of them denied the messengers, so My threat came true.
50:15: Were We tired by the first creation? Nay, they are in doubt about a new creation.
50:16: And indeed, We created man, and We know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
50:17: Two receivers seated on the right and on the left receive.
50:18: He utters no word without there being a watcher ready beside him.
50:19: And the stupor of death has come with the truth. That is what you were fleeing from.
50:20: And the Sur was blown; that is the promised Day.
50:21: Every soul came, along with a driver and a witness.
50:22: Indeed, you were heedless of this, so We removed your veil from you, and today your sight is sharp.
50:23: His companion says: 'This is what is ready with me.'
50:24: Cast, you two, into Hell every stubborn ungrateful one!
50:26: He who made another god along with Allah; cast him, you two, into the severe punishment!
50:27: His companion said: 'Our Rabb, I did not make him transgress, but he was in a far straying.'
50:28: He said: 'Do not dispute before Me, I had already sent the threat to you beforehand.'
50:29: With Me the word is not changed, and I am not unjust to the servants.
50:30: That Day We will say to Hell: 'Are you filled?' and it will say: 'Is there any more?'
50:31: And Paradise was brought near to the people of taqwa, not far.
50:32: This is what was promised to you, for every turning and preserving one.
50:33: He who fears the Rahman in the unseen and comes with a turning heart.
50:34: Enter it in peace; this is the Day of eternal abiding.
50:35: For them therein is whatever they wish, and with Us is more.
50:36: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were stronger than them. They made holes in the cities. Was there any escape?
50:37: Indeed, in that there is surely a reminder for whoever has a heart or gives ear while being present.
50:38: And indeed, We created the heavens, the earth, and what is between them in six days, and no weariness touched Us.
50:39: Be patient over what they say, and glorify with praise of your Rabb before the rising of the sun and before its setting.
50:40: And during a part of the night glorify Him, and after the prostrations.
50:41: And listen on that Day when the caller calls from a near place.
50:42: That Day they hear the shout in truth; that is the Day of emergence.
50:43: Indeed, it is We who give life and We who cause death, and to Us is the return.
50:44: That Day the earth splits swiftly from them; that is a gathering easy for Us.
50:45: We know best what they say, and you are not a tyrant over them; so remind with the Qur'an those who fear My threat.
